title: Across the Golden Ladder (Lyngba Jingkieng Ksiar)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Lyngba ka jingkieng ksier ba donburom,
Ki Hynniewtrep ki la kiew la hiar;
Ha Lum Sohpetbneng ka ri ba pyngngad,
Ban ri ia ka hok bad ban kamai ia ka spah.

Mynsiem bakhuid ko Blei U Kynrad,
To da to synran ia la ki khun;
Ba kin ym thut ha lynti ba khim,
Ban neh ha ka burom jong ka jaitbynriew.
lyrics_english:
Across the glorious golden ladder of old,
The Seven Celestial Huts traversed between earth and sky;
Upon Mount Sohpetbneng in the tranquil highlands,
To guard sacred righteousness and earn true life.

Holy Creator and Sovereign Lord,
Protect and guide Thy mortal children;
That they stumble not upon the narrow path,
Preserving forever the honor of their ancestral race.
